title: Club Walkway Officially Opened
excerpt: The new 1.2km floodlit walkway around the main pitch was officially opened on Saturday, a fantastic facility for the whole community.
body:
The new 1.2km floodlit walkway around the main pitch was officially opened on Saturday, a fantastic facility for the whole community.

The walkway is open to the public every day from 7am to 10pm and is suitable for buggies and wheelchairs.

A huge thank you to the volunteers who gave up their weekends, and to our sponsors whose support made the project possible.
